node.statement: Because Delta is UCP by 1.2, def-ucp-map says every amplification Delta_n is unital positive and therefore contractive. Consequently ||Delta_n X Delta_n Y||<=||Delta_n X||*||Delta_n Y||<=||X||*||Y||; also the C*-algebra norm on M_n(S.B) gives ||XY||<=||X||*||Y||.
